info.title: Tandem API
info.description: Authentication, administration and the chat skeleton. Cookie-authenticated; state-changing calls need the X-CSRF-Token header returned by GET /api/auth/me.

get.summary: Query the audit log, newest first.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Only this event type, for example `auth.sign_in.failure`.

parameters.name: after_time
parameters.description: Page cursor: the `next_after_time` of the previous page.

parameters.name: after_id
parameters.description: Page cursor: the `next_after_id` of the previous page.

post.summary: Invite someone. Nothing is emailed; the link is returned once.
Deactivate a user and end their sign-ins.
Issue a one-time password-reset link for a user.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their scope and the CSRF token.

post.summary: Confirm enrolment with a code; returns the recovery codes once.
Begin MFA enrolment: returns the secret to show once.
Replace the recovery codes; returns the new set once.
Sign in with email, password and, when enrolled, a second factor.

get.summary: The caller's chat sessions, newest first.
The messages of one of the caller's sessions, oldest first.

post.summary: Post a message; the agent's reply arrives over the event feed.
Accept an invitation: creates the account and signs in.

get.summary: Whether first-run setup is still open.

post.summary: Create the first admin and sign in with an enrolment-only scope.

mfa_enrolled.description: Whether the user has confirmed MFA.

AdminUserDto.description: A user in the admin list, with their MFA state.

actor_label.description: The actor's name at the time.

details.description: Extra facts, with secrets already removed.

AuditPageDto.description: A page of audit entries, newest first.

next_after_time.description: Pass these two values back as `after_time` and `after_id` for the next page.

author.description: The user ID or the agent's name.

in_reply_to.description: The message this answers, for agent replies.

code.description: A current authenticator or recovery code.

EnrolmentResponse.description: The MFA secret to show once.

otpauth_uri.description: The `otpauth://` URI for a QR code.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error answer.

message.description: A plain-words message safe to show to the user.

FieldProblem.description: One field problem in a validation answer.

field.description: The field as the client knows it.

InvitationDto.description: An invitation in the admin list.

InvitationInfoDto.description: What an invitation link is for.

InviteCreatedDto.description: A new invitation with its one-time link.

link.description: The link to give to the invitee; shown once.

MeResponse.description: The signed-in user, their scope and the CSRF token for state-changing calls.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

ResetInfoDto.description: Whose password a reset link is for.

link.description: The link to give to the user.

reset_mfa.description: Also remove the user's MFA enrolment.

SecondFactorDto.description: A second factor submitted with sign-in.

absolute_duration_seconds.description: Sign out after this many seconds in total.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Sign out after this many idle seconds.

online_breach_check.description: Also check passwords against the online breach service.

SessionStarted.description: A session started by setup or invitation acceptance.

SetupStatus.description: Whether first-run setup is still open.

available.description: True until the first admin exists.

oneOf.description: Required when the account has MFA.

SignInResponse.description: The result of a sign-in step.

TokenRequest.description: A link token from an invitation or reset link.

UserDto.description: A user as the client sees them.

last_sign_in_at.description: The last successful sign-in, if any.
